'''Zhichun''' is an NPC in {{Location|Hongzhen}}. A child from [[Hongzhen]] who can be found with her mother, [[Xiangyi]].

==Dialogue==
{{Dialogue Start}}
:;(First interaction)
{{Stub Dialogue}}
----
:;(Second interaction)
:'''Zhichun:''' ...
:{{DIcon}} Hello.
:{{DIcon}} What are you looking at?
:'''Zhichun:''' Oh, it's you. I remember you!
:'''Zhichun:''' It was you and the [[Jinhsi|Magistrate]] who saved us all!
:Several researchers from [[Jinzhou]] happen to pass by. Zhichun clings to you, nervous and curious.
:'''Zhichun:''' ...
:{{DIcon}} What's wrong?
:'''Zhichun:''' That's because... because a lot of grown-ups have come here lately.
:'''Zhichun:''' Maybe not that many, but I've never seen so many strangers in my life.
:'''Zhichun:''' I-I'm just a little scared. But they seem quite interesting. 
:'''Zhichun:''' And Mom said I can say hi to them when I'm with trustworthy grown-ups.
:'''Zhichun:''' But... But...
:{{DIcon}} I can introduce you to them.
:'''Zhichun:''' Really?
:{{DIcon}} (Introduce the person in a white gown.)
::'''Zhichun:''' Hua... Huashi Academy... That's such a difficult name to pronounce.
::'''Zhichun:''' But I now know everyone in a white gown is very impressive, very smart!
:{{DIcon}} (Introduce the person wearing a bamboo hat.)
::'''Zhichun:''' Logistics person of [[Lollo Logistics]]... Hehe, that sounds like one of Grandma's tongue-twisters.
::'''Zhichun:''' I know the people wearing bamboo hats deliver stuff to people now.
:{{DIcon}} (Introduce the person in a blue uniform.)
::'''Zhichun:''' [[Midnight Rangers]]... I like that! Easy to remember and has a nice ring to it!
::'''Zhichun:''' So the people in neat blue uniforms are here to protect us!
:{{DIcon|Arrow}} That's everybody.
:'''Zhichun:''' Thank you. I'm trying my best to remember them!
:'''Zhichun:''' Mmm... after hearing you tell me all that, I'm suddenly not scared anymore...
----
:;(Third interaction)
:'''Zhichun:''' Mom, that lady in the blue, uh, uniform is a Midnight Ranger.
:'''Zhichun:''' And that man in the long white gown is a Hua... Hua...
:'''Xiangyi:''' Hehe, Huaxu-
:'''Zhichun:''' Yeah, a researcher from [[Huaxu Academy]].
:'''Zhichun:''' Oh, oh, and I know him too! He's a logistics person from Lollo Logistics!
{{Dialogue End}}
